description: Place the order with the shop (like the checkout). Only after the customer confirmed the quoted order and accepted the terms (terms_url). Paid by card in advance on the shop's order page: returns the order number and order_url (with "Betal nu"; the shop gets the order when paid). The customer gets a confirmation e-mail when paid. With products with an age limit and no approved age_check_id, nothing is ordered: returns status age_check_required with the AltID card; call again with age_check_id when the age is confirmed.

accepted_terms.description: true when the customer has accepted the shop's terms (terms_url)

age_check_id.description: Products with an age limit: the approved age check (from start_age_check or the age_check_required card); one age check can be reused for 30 minutes across shops

comment.description: A note for the shop, e.g. "no onions"

customer.description: Required unless the customer is logged in on this shop (then taken from the account; my_profile shows it)

options.description: Answers to the product's options from get_menu (option_id + choice_id, option_id + text, or option_id + choices for choose_many). Required options must be answered; ask the customer, never pick for them.

text.description: The customer's own words, e.g. "uden løg"

choices.description: choose_many: the chosen choices; the total must be between min_total and max_total

other_stops.description: The other orders you are placing for the customer in this conversation (other shops, same day): used only to warn when they are too far apart in time (trip_warnings). Nothing is looked up about the customer.

shop.description: The "shop" value from find_shops (not needed on a shop's own address <shop>.lenius.app/mcp)

name: place_order
title: Place order
